{{Top|leg}}
The '''symbiospore''' was a [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] that looked like a broad frond. It grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] and produced its breathable [[atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref><ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The symbiospore infected the upper bare branches of the [[Gankto tree]] in [[Arblis Forest]], stealing nutrients from it. Its metabolism and crude photosynthesis produced air, but with a pungent moldy aroma. As a result, off-world visitors, even as far as [[Tal'cara]], thought that the atmosphere smelled like moldy [[cheese/Legends|cheese]].<ref name="guide" /><ref name="sotes">

Its spores were mildly poisonous for other beings, such as [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], but were [[foodstuff/Legends|food]] for [[Millitile/Legends|millitiles]], who also moved around the upper branches of the gankto. The spores's residue in millitiles's mouth could inflict a being when they got bit by them.<ref name="guide" />
